system.description:
Assamite justice is swift and merciless. This power uses the blood of the individual being questioned to divine not only the truth of his words, but the truth behind them. The interrogator pours a Blood Trait of the subject's vitae into his hand and holds it for the questioning; the blood smolders and gives off a thin red mist, and is consumed by the scene's end.

The character must have at least one Blood Trait of the subject's vitae. The player makes a Social Challenge (Perception/Subterfuge) against the target's Willpower for each statement examined. One success reveals whether a statement is a lie, partial truth, or the whole truth; two successes reveal the emotional motive behind a lie; three successes reveal the whole truth as the target consciously knows it; four successes reveal everything the target knows about the subject, even forgotten or suppressed knowledge; five successes grant hazy visions of the actual truth, even facts the target never knew. Costs 15 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
